screen.reason: The paper reports an experiment comparing a vanilla LLM (no retrieval) against retrieval-augmented conditions (retrieve-then-read and RAG) using the same model.

The paper reports that the RAG pipeline has a higher unsupported-answer rate (40.2%) than the closed-book model (33.5%), contradicting the abstract's claim that retrieval reduces hallucinations, and thus does not report the expected positive comparison of retrieval-augmented vs. non-retrieval performance.
The paper explicitly compares a retrieval-augmented generator against a parametric-only model (answering without retrieval) using the same underlying model and benchmark.
